name: Integration question (CRM, Sheets, WhatsApp, email, booking, transfer)
trigger: The prospect asks whether the AI Sales Employee connects to their CRM or Google Sheets, sends WhatsApp or email, books meetings in a calendar, or transfers calls live.
content: {"steps":[{"type":"say","message":"الربط مع الـ CRM وجوجل شيت والواتساب والإيميل وحجز المواعيد لسه قيد التطوير ومش متاح النهارده. النهارده كل مكالمة بتطلع بنتيجة وملخص منظم بيتسلّم لفريقكم.","message_translations":{"en":{"value":"Integrations with CRM, Google Sheets, WhatsApp, email and calendar booking are still in development and not available today. Today, every call produces a structured outcome and summary for your team."}}},{"type":"tell","instruction":"If they ask for technical specifics beyond the knowledge base, say our team can cover them in a meeting. Otherwise continue the conversation where it was."}]}
